title: In Taiwan, Turning Trash into Sunglasses (1/2)
titleZh: 在台灣，把垃圾變成太陽眼鏡 (1/2)
summaryZh: 台北的零廢棄工作坊讓民眾親手把塑膠垃圾做成太陽眼鏡，推廣循環時尚。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — As It Is

sentences.text: A workshop in Taipei, Taiwan, is giving new life to bottle caps, food packaging, old toys, and other kinds of plastic waste.
sentences.zh: 台灣台北的一間工作坊，讓瓶蓋、食品包裝、舊玩具等各種塑膠垃圾重獲新生。

sentences.text: The Zero Waste Workshop, known as Trash Kitchen, gives people hands-on experience in the recycling process.
sentences.zh: 這個名為「垃圾廚房」的零廢棄工作坊，讓大家親手體驗回收的過程。

sentences.text: People take plastic waste, then soften and shape it into a pair of sunglasses within two hours.
sentences.zh: 參加的人拿塑膠垃圾來軟化、塑形，兩個小時內就能做出一副太陽眼鏡。

sentences.text: Arthur Wong started the company that holds the workshop.
sentences.zh: 舉辦這個工作坊的公司是 Arthur Wong 創立的。

sentences.text: He spoke to Reuters News Agency.
sentences.zh: 他接受了路透社的訪問。

sentences.text: He said, what we are trying to show in the Trash Kitchen is to let you see, feel,
sentences.zh: 他說，我們在「垃圾廚房」想呈現的，就是讓你親眼看到、親身感受、

sentences.text: touch within minutes how this process can actually work without secondary pollution, and you can actually turn it into something of value directly in front of you.
sentences.zh: 在幾分鐘內親手摸到這個過程如何真的運作、又不會產生二次污染，而且就在你眼前把垃圾變成有價值的東西。

sentences.text: Wong is the founder of MiniWiz.
sentences.zh: Wong 是 MiniWiz 的創辦人。

sentences.text: The company recycles waste material into goods that people want to buy.
sentences.zh: 這家公司把廢棄材料回收，變成大家願意買的商品。

sentences.text: MiniWiz also produces tiles, bricks, hangers, and other daily necessities from plastic and organic waste.
sentences.zh: MiniWiz 也用塑膠和有機廢棄物做出磁磚、磚塊、衣架等日常用品。

sentences.text: Wong said the company uses a machine it developed in 2017 called a Mini Trash Presso.
sentences.zh: Wong 說，公司使用一台 2017 年自行研發、名為 Mini Trash Presso 的機器。

sentences.text: The machine processes the waste material for a new use.
sentences.zh: 這台機器會處理廢棄材料，讓它們有新的用途。

sentences.text: Cora Shea is editor-in-chief for fashion magazine Harper's Bazaar Taiwan.
sentences.zh: Cora Shea 是時尚雜誌《哈潑時尚》台灣版的總編輯。

sentences.text: Shea said the project making sunglasses is a good way to bring attention to sustainable fashion.
sentences.zh: Shea 說，做太陽眼鏡這個計畫，是讓大家關注永續時尚的好方法。

sentences.text: I think environmental protection and fashion still have a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 我覺得環保和時尚還有很長的一段路要走。
